## What's Changed

- Choose FakeIP or real-IP (redir-host) DNS independently of TUN, TUN + Mixed, or Mixed inbound mode. Existing installations retain their previous effective DNS mode during upgrade.
- Preserve persisted FakeIP mappings when switching to real-IP DNS, including Mixed proxies, so clients with cached virtual addresses can continue connecting. New DNS answers follow the selected mode.
- Speed up cached GeoIP and GeoSite rule-set requests by reusing category indexes and successful SRS validation results instead of repeatedly parsing entire databases and launching core validation processes.
- Reduce repeated allocations when browsing GeoSite domain pages with a bounded category cache. Data-file changes invalidate cached reads, and core updates invalidate previous rule-set validation results.
- Allow independent Geo categories to load concurrently while preventing duplicate compilation of the same category and protecting database snapshots during conversion.

### DNS mode changes

After saving a DNS mode change, regenerate, validate, and apply the configuration for it to take effect. Avoid clearing FakeIP mappings or changing the FakeIP address pools during the transition.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ackwrap/ackrun/compare/v1.0.9...v1.0.10
